build_MMDetBackbone: build an MMDetBackbone wrapper from an mmdet config dict with pretrained weights and output shapes
build_MMDetDetector: build an MMDetDetector wrapper from an mmdet config dict with pixel normalization for detectron2 training
run_MMDetBackbone_forward: run the MMDetBackbone forward pass on an image tensor and return a dict of feature tensors
run_MMDetDetector_forward: run the MMDetDetector forward pass on batched inputs for training or inference with detection results
review_convert_mmdet_result: review the _convert_mmdet_result function that converts mmdet detection results to detectron2 Instances format
